meta.playoff_rule: A player must play 6 of the 10 scheduled weeks to be playoff eligible.
notes: Player 3DA, PPD, MPR, checkout rate, and W–L are weighted from the team workbook through Week 5.
100+, 140+, 180s, high turn, and checkout scores are from the DartConnect weekly export (Weeks 1–4). Week 5–6 visit scores were not in that export.
First-nine average, division ranks, and 5/7/9-mark rounds are the DartConnect roster export (through Week 4).
Team results and the division table are scored from the division schedule through Week 6. The DartConnect standings file in sources/ is the Week 4 snapshot.
Week 6 individual lines are on the scoresheet photo and are not in the workbook, so they are not in the player averages.
Attendance through Week 6 counts a player present only when he shot that night on the paper scoresheet. Playoffs need 6 of 10 regular-season weeks. 4 weeks have not been played.

attendance.rule: A player counts as present for a week only if they shot that night per the paper scoresheet. Playoff eligibility: 6 of the 10 regular-season weeks in the half.
